title: Add AGENTS.md for Cursor Cloud development environment
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud-specific development instructions so future agents can quickly set up and work in this codebase. ## What's included - Key commands (dev server, lint, test, typecheck, build) - Non-obvious caveat: `VITE_BASE_PATH="/"` must be set for local dev server routing - Notes on German UI labels, lack of external services, and `@/` path alias ## Environment verification All checks pass on the current `main` branch: | Check | Result | |---|---| | `pnpm run lint` | Pass (0 errors) | | `pnpm test` | 505 tests passing across 40 test files | | `pnpm run typecheck` | Pass (no errors) | | `pnpm run build` | Production build succeeds | | Dev server (`pnpm run dev`) | Serves at localhost:5173, HTTP 200 | | Hello-world: create a season | Season "Testsaison 2026" created successfully | ## Demo Season creation and navigation working in the Vite dev server. ![Season created and opened in the app](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-e92898a9-67d0-4003-8e61-eda703ed63a9)
